resources.string: To use Google Drive, pick it in the file picker.
Bring your messages over from another SMS app
Switching to uMessage? Your old messages can come with you.
In your old app, make a backup. In SMS Backup & Restore, tap Back up now.
Save the backup to Google Drive or to a file on your phone.
Come back here, tap Import messages and pick that file.
uMessage reads the XML files made by SMS Backup & Restore, as well as its own backups.
